title: Sum of Root To Leaf Binary Numbers
summary: Given a binary tree with nodes having values 0 or 1, calculate the sum of binary numbers represented by each root-to-leaf path.
statement: Given a binary tree with nodes having values 0 or 1, calculate the sum of binary numbers represented by each root-to-leaf path. Each path's binary number is formed by concatenating the node values from the root to the leaf. The sum is computed for all leaf nodes, and the result is a 32-bit integer.
constraints: Every node value is zero or one and the tree is nonempty.
Interpret each root-to-leaf path as binary and sum the values.
